Container.Name: Gramglean
Container.Overview: Paste Instagram links, glean every image. Gramglean downloads the full-resolution media from Instagram posts and reels — every image in a carousel, not just the visible ones — with optional cookie login for private posts, parallel downloads, a built-in gallery, and detailed failure logs.
Container.Description: Self-hosted Instagram link downloader. Paste one or more post/reel links and Gramglean archives every image and video in them at full resolution, including complete carousels. Re-submitting a link skips what is already archived. Supports multiple cookies.txt files with rotation, optional at-rest cookie encryption, and writes a detailed log entry for every resource that could not be downloaded.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership (Unraid default 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership (Unraid default 100 = users).

Config.Name: Download threads
Config.Description: Parallel download workers. Higher is faster but increases rate-limit risk.

Config.Name: Max concurrent jobs
Config.Description: How many jobs run at once. Keep at 1 to minimise rate-limit risk.

Config.Name: Rate limit min (s)
Config.Description: Minimum randomized delay between Instagram post fetches.

Config.Name: Rate limit max (s)
Config.Description: Maximum randomized delay between Instagram post fetches.

Config.Name: Log retention (days)
Config.Description: Per-job log files older than this are deleted at startup.

Config.Name: Cookie encryption key
Config.Description: Optional. Encrypts cookie files at rest (AES-256-GCM). Leave blank for plaintext. Generate with: python -c "import secrets,base64;print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode())"
